h_wording.H410: Very toxic to aquatic life with long lasting effects
h_wording.H413: May cause long lasting harmful effects to aquatic life

presence.note: A UVB filter the maker adds; it also steadies avobenzone.

why_it_matters.text: A UVB filter, absorbing near 303 nm, that also steadies avobenzone: it takes up the energy avobenzone absorbs before sunlight can break that filter apart.

approval.product: OTC Monograph M020, Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-the-Counter Human Use
approval.basis: FDA OTC monograph. M020.10(k), "Octocrylene up to 10 percent", in M020 as amended by Final Administrative Order OTC000039 (issued 2026-06-10, corrected 2026-08-10); the later order OTC000008-1 (Federal Register 2026-09-11) removed only aminobenzoic acid and trolamine salicylate. Checked 2026-11-14.

description: A UVB filter, absorbing near 303 nm, that also steadies avobenzone: it takes up the energy avobenzone absorbs before sunlight can break that filter apart.

parts.label: The ester group
parts.sentence: A C=O joined through an oxygen to another carbon, the link an acid and an alcohol make when they combine. Water can split it back into the two.

parts.label: The benzene ring
parts.sentence: Six carbons in a flat hexagon, sharing their electrons evenly around the ring. It is stable, flat and oily, and it stacks readily against other flat rings.
